paite: Huan zawlnei Elisha in zawlneite tapate lak a khat asam a, akiang ah, "Na puan teng inla, hiai sathau bawm tawi inla, Ramoth-gilead ah va hoh in.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Ding In Jehu Thaunilh Ahi

paite: Na va tun chiang in Nimshi tapa Jehoshaphat tapa Jehu va zongkhia inla; va lut inla, a-unaute lak a pan samkhia inla, dantan sunggil ah lutpih in.
Huchi in sathau bawm la inla, alu ah sung inla, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Israelte tung a kumpipa ding in sathau ka hon nilh hi," chi in. "Huchi in kong hong inla, taikhia in, om sawt ke'n,” achi hi.
Huchi in tangval, zawlnei tangvalpa Ramoth-gilead ah ahohta hi.

Ava tunleh ngai in, sepaih heutute atukhawm ua; ama'n, "Sepaih heutu, na kiang a gen ding thukhah ka nei," achi hi. Jehu in, "Kua pen kiang ah eita?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Nang kiang ah, sepaih heutupa," achi hi,
Athou a, inn ah alut a; alu ah sathau asung a, akiang ah, "ToUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: TOUPA mipite, Israelte tung a kumpipa ding in thau ka hon nilh hi.
Ka sikha zawlneite sisan leh TOUPA sikha tengteng sisan phu Jezebel tung a ka laktheihna ding in na pu Ahab inkote na that ding hi.
Ahab inko tengteng amangthang vek ding uh. Ahab a pan pasal taphot Israel gam a zalen hi in sikha hitaleh ka hihmang ding hi.
Ahab inkote Nebat tapa Jeroboam inkote leh Ahijah tapa Baasha inkote bang in ka bawl ding hi.
Uite'n Jezreel khokulh zul ah Jezebel ane ding ua, amah vui ding mi a-om kei ding, chi in," achi hi. Huchi in kong ahong a, ataikheta hi.

Huchi in Jehu bel atoupa sikhate kiang ah ahong pawt a; khat in akiang ah, "Hoih lam thu hia? Huai mihaipa koi a pan na kiang a hong ahia?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Huai mi na thei ua; athugen leng na thei uh," achi hi.
Amau, "Thei maizen dia, tu'n hon hilh in," achi uh. Ama'n, "Hichibang in ahon chi ahi: 'TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Israelte tung a kumpipa ding in sathau ka hon nilh hi, " achi hi.
Huchi in michih in apuan uh asuah somsom ua, kailawn tung ah aphahsak chiat ua, "Jehu kumpipa ahita," chi in pengkul amutta uhi.
Huchi in Nimshi tapa Jehoshaphat tapa Jehu in Joram thahna ding aguksawm hi. Siria kumpipa Hazael ziak in Joram leh Israelte tengteng in Ramoth-gilead khua aveng uhi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Joram Thah Ahi

paite: Siria kumpipa Hazael toh kumpipa Joram akidouna ua Siria mite'n asukliam uh, Jezreel a kidamsak ding in akik nawn hi. Huchi in Jehu in, "Kei lam a pang na hih uleh kuamah Jezreel a hiai thu gen ding in khua a pan paikhesak kei un," achi hi.
Huchi in Jehu bel kangtalai ah atuang a, Jezreel ah ahoh a, huai ah Joram alum hi. Judah kumpipa Ahaziah leng Joram veh ding in ahohsuk hi.

Jezreel kulh ah galvilmi adingh a, Jehu pawlte amah toh hong pai amu a, “Mi tampi ka mu,” achi hi. Joram in, "Sakol tungtuangmi amau va dawn ding in sawl inla, hoih lam thu hia? va chi uhen,” achi hi.

Huchi in mi khat sakol tung a tuang amau dawn ding in akuan a, kumpipa'n hichi in achi, “Lemna thu toh hong pai na hi hia?” achi hi. Jehu in, "Lemna thu toh hong pai leng, nang na theih ding bang a-om a? Ka nung ah pai in," achi hi. Galvilmi'n, "I mi sawl akiang uh ava tung a, himahleh ahong kik nawn het kei mawk a," chi in ahilh hi.

Huchi in mi khat sakol tung a tuang asawl nawn a, huai mi leng akiang uh ava tung a, kumpipa'n hichi in achi, "Lemna thu toh hong pai na hi hia?" achi hi. Jehu in adawng a, "Lemna thu toh hong pai leng, nang na theih ding bang a-om a? Ka nung ah pai in,” achi hi.
Galvilmi leng akiang uh ava tung a, amah leng ahong kik nawn het kei mawk hi. "Huai kangtalai kihawldan leng Nimshi tapa Jehu hawldan geih ahi; mihai bang mai in ahawl hi," achi hi.

Joram in, "Kimansak un," achi a; kangtalai akimansakta uh. Huchi in Israel kumpipa Joram leh Judah kumpipa Ahaziah amau kangtalai tuaktuak in ava pawtkhia ua, Jehu tuak ding in ataikhia ua, Jezreel mi Naboth huan ah ava mu uhi.
Joram in Jehu amuh in hichi ahong hi a, "Lemna toh hong pai na hia, Jehu?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Na nu Jezebel angkawmna leh bumna atam lai teng bangchi in lemna a-om thei dia?" achi hi.
Joram akihei a, atai a, Ahaziah kiang ah, "Kikhem a kilehbawlna om ei ve, Ahaziah," achi hi.
Jehu in athalpeu atheihtawp in alai a, Joram liang leh liang kikal ah akap a, thaltang in alungtang apailet a, akangtalai sung ah apuklut hi.
Huchi in Jehu in asepaih heutu Bidkar kiang ah, "Dom inla, Jezreel mi Naboth huan ah paikhia in. Tuma lam a nang toh apa Ahab nung a i tuankhawm lai a TOUPA'N hiai puakgik atung ah anga hi.

TOUPA'N zan in Naboth sisan leh atapate sisan ka muh ngei ahi," achi hi. "TOUPA'N, hiai mun ngei ah ka hon thuk ding," achi nawn hi. Huchi in "TOUPA thu bang in dom inla, hiai mun ngei ah paikhia in," achi hi.

Himahleh Judah kumpipa Ahaziah in huai amuh in huan in lampi ah atai hi. Jehu in adelh a, "Amah leng huai kangtalai sung ah that un," achi hi. Huchi in Ibleam kiang, Gur zottouhna ah asatliam uhi. Meggiddo ah atailut a, huai ah asita hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Ahaziah Thah Ahi

paite: Amite'n Jerusalem ah kangtalai in apaipih ua, amah han ah, api-le- pute lak ah David khopi ah avui uhi.
Ahab tapa Joram kum sawm- le-khat alal kum in Judahte tung ah Ahaziah alal pan hi.
Jezreel ah Jehu ava lut chih Jezebel in ana za hi. Huchi in amitte anuh a, asam azem a, tohlet ah ana dakkhia hi.
heading: Kumpinu Jezebel Thah Ahi

paite: Jehu kulh kongpi a, ahong lut laitak in, "Na pu thatpa nang Zimri, lemna thu toh hong pai na hi hia?" ana chi hi.
Tohlet lam nga in amah adaktou a, "Kei lam a pang kuakua na om ua? Kua?" achi hi. Michilgeh nih hiam, thum hiam amah lam nga in ahong dakkhia uhi.
Ama'n, "Hon lawnkhia un," achi hi. Huchi in alawnkhia ua; asi khenkhat in baang leh sakolte atheh nengnung a; ama'n lei ah akhe in ana chil hi.
Huchi in alut a, ne in adawn a, "Hamse thuaknu va dom unla, va vui un, kumpipa tanu lah ahi ngal a." achi hi.
Vui ding in akuan ua; himahleh aluguh, akhebomte leh akhutpek bomte kia lou ngal amu kei uh.
Huchi in ahong pai nawn in ahong hilh uh. Ama'n, "Hiai TOUPA'N asikha Tishbi mi Elijah zang a, Jezreel kulhchin ah uite'n Jezebel ane ding ua;
Jezebel luang Jezreel khokulh chin a huan a ekchim bang ahi dia, huchi a, hiai Jezebel ei ve, achihlouhna ding un, chi a agen ahi," achi hi.
